description: This file defines the 'Language' entity class, which models language data within the sales management system. It includes properties like id, code, and sortOrder, and manages relationships to MerchantStore entities.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Entity class representing a language in the system, with fields for id, code, sortOrder, and relationships to merchant stores. Implements auditing via AuditSection and linkage to persistence annotations.
